hints.en: The position of the top score: `max(range(len(row)), key=lambda i: row[i])`.
Count the hits and divide by the number of queries.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def precision_at_1(scores, doc_labels, query_labels):
    hits = 0
    for row, label in zip(scores, query_labels):
        best = max(range(len(row)), key=lambda i: row[i])
        hits += doc_labels[best] == label
    return round(hits / len(query_labels), 3)

scores = [[0.9, 0.1, 0.3], [0.2, 0.1, 0.8], [0.5, 0.6, 0.1]]
print(precision_at_1(scores, ["a", "b", "c"], ["a", "b", "b"]))
```
